Library

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(xgboost)
library(lightgbm)
library(Matrix)
library(stringr)
library(ranger)
library(rpart)    # Untuk Decision Tree
library(ggplot2)  # Untuk Visualisasi yang cantik
library(rpart.plot)

1. Mengumpulkan Data

# Membaca dataset dari file CSV
train_data <- read.csv("D:/Kuliah/Semester 6/ADS BNSP/train_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
test_data <- read.csv("D:/Kuliah/Semester 6/ADS BNSP/test_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Menyimpan kolom 'x' dari test_data ke dalam variabel terpisah. 
# Ini krusial karena akan digunakan untuk format submission di tahap akhir.
test_x <- test_data$x

# Menambahkan kolom target 'total.price' dengan nilai NA pada data test
test_data$total.price <- NA

# Menambahkan penanda (flag) untuk membedakan asal baris data
train_data$is_train <- TRUE
test_data$is_train <- FALSE

# Menggabungkan kedua data menjadi satu kesatuan
full_data <- bind_rows(train_data, test_data)

4. Menentukan Objek Data

# Kolom 'x' hanya indeks, tidak berguna untuk prediksi.
# Kolom city seringkali redundan karena sudah diwakili oleh airport.code.
kolom_dibuang <- c("x", "departure.city", "arrival.city")

full_data <- full_data %>% 
  select(-all_of(kolom_dibuang))

5. Membersihkan Data

full_data <- full_data %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Ekstraksi maskapai utama
    primary_carrier = str_extract(carriers, "[A-Z0-9]+"),
    
    # 2. Bikin Detektor Pola JSON:
    is_json_bleed = (!is.na(cabin_massUnit) & str_detect(cabin_massUnit, "\\[\\{")) |
                    (!is.na(cabin_sizeUnit) & str_detect(cabin_sizeUnit, "\\[\\{"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # 3. EKSTRAKSI NILAI maxPiece SECARA DINAMIS
    # Logika Regex: Cari teks "'maxPiece': [angka]", lalu ekstrak [angka]-nya saja, ubah jadi numerik.
    # Kalau tidak kena JSON bleed, biarkan nilai cabin_maxPiece aslinya utuh.
    cabin_maxPiece = ifelse(
      is_json_bleed, 
      as.numeric(str_extract(str_extract(cabin_massUnit, "'maxPiece': \\d+"), "\\d+")), 
      cabin_maxPiece
    ),
    
    # 4. Benerin Satuan yang Bocor
    # Timpa teks JSON dengan satuan sejenis yang ada di data
    cabin_massUnit = ifelse(is_json_bleed, "LB", cabin_massUnit),
    cabin_sizeUnit = ifelse(is_json_bleed, "INCH", cabin_sizeUnit)
  ) %>%
  
  # 5. Buang kolom detektor buatan
  select(-is_json_bleed)
library(dplyr)

full_data <- full_data %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Sapu bersih parasit "[]" jadi NA murni
    checked_luggageType = na_if(as.character(checked_luggageType), "[]"),
    checked_ruleType = na_if(as.character(checked_ruleType), "[]")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # 2. Imputasi checked_luggageType berdasarkan berat koper
    checked_luggageType = case_when(
      # Kalau datanya aslinya ada, biarin aja
      !is.na(checked_luggageType) ~ checked_luggageType,
      
      # Kalau beratnya 0 atau kosong, pasti ga dapet bagasi
      checked_maxTotalWeight == 0 | is.na(checked_maxTotalWeight) ~ "NONE",
      
      # Kalau beratnya > 0 tapi tipenya kosong, otomatis asumsikan CHECKED_IN
      TRUE ~ "CHECKED_IN"
    ),
    
    # 3. Imputasi checked_ruleType
    checked_ruleType = case_when(
      !is.na(checked_ruleType) ~ checked_ruleType,
      
      # Kalau ga dapet bagasi, ya aturannya ga ada (NONE)
      checked_maxTotalWeight == 0 | is.na(checked_maxTotalWeight) ~ "NONE",
      
      # Kalau dapet bagasi tapi aturannya kosong, asumsikan WEIGHT_BASED
      # (karena di Indonesia mayoritas penerbangan domestik pakai sistem berat, bukan jumlah koper)
      TRUE ~ "WEIGHT_BASED"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Kembalikan ke format factor
    checked_luggageType = as.factor(checked_luggageType),
    checked_ruleType = as.factor(checked_ruleType)
  )
#view(full_data)
full_data <- full_data %>%
  mutate(
    # --- A. PERSIAPAN FITUR MASKAPAI ---
    # Mengekstrak maskapai utama dari format array string (misal: "['ID', 'ID']" menjadi "ID")
    primary_carrier = str_extract(carriers, "[A-Z0-9]+")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # --- B. KELOMPOK BAGASI TERCATAT (CHECKED BAGGAGE) ---
    # Logika: MNAR (Missing Not at Random). NA berarti tidak ada jatah bagasi gratis.
    checked_maxPiece = ifelse(is.na(checked_maxPiece), 0, checked_maxPiece),
    checked_maxTotalWeight = ifelse(is.na(checked_maxTotalWeight), 0, checked_maxTotalWeight),
    checked_maxWeightPerPiece = ifelse(is.na(checked_maxWeightPerPiece) | checked_maxWeightPerPiece == "NA", 
                                       0, as.numeric(checked_maxWeightPerPiece)),
    
    checked_luggageType = ifelse(is.na(checked_luggageType) | checked_luggageType == "", "NONE", checked_luggageType),
    checked_ruleType = ifelse(is.na(checked_ruleType) | checked_ruleType == "", "NONE", checked_ruleType),
    
    checked_massUnit = ifelse(is.na(checked_massUnit) | checked_massUnit == "", "KG", checked_massUnit),
    checked_travellerReference = ifelse(is.na(checked_travellerReference), 0, checked_travellerReference)
  ) %>%
  
  # --- C. KELOMPOK DIMENSI & BERAT KABIN (CABIN BAGGAGE) - MULTI-GROUP IMPUTATION ---
  group_by(kelas, primary_carrier) %>% 
  mutate(
    cabin_maxLength = ifelse(is.na(cabin_maxLength), median(cabin_maxLength, na.rm = TRUE), cabin_maxLength),
    cabin_maxWidth = ifelse(is.na(cabin_maxWidth), median(cabin_maxWidth, na.rm = TRUE), cabin_maxWidth),
    cabin_maxHeight = ifelse(is.na(cabin_maxHeight), median(cabin_maxHeight, na.rm = TRUE), cabin_maxHeight),
    
    # Menambahkan imputasi Grouped Median untuk berat kabin
    cabin_maxWeightPerPiece = ifelse(is.na(cabin_maxWeightPerPiece), median(cabin_maxWeightPerPiece, na.rm = TRUE), cabin_maxWeightPerPiece)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  # --- D. JARING PENGAMAN (FALLBACK IMPUTATION) ---
  mutate(
    cabin_maxLength = ifelse(is.na(cabin_maxLength), median(cabin_maxLength, na.rm = TRUE), cabin_maxLength),
    cabin_maxWidth = ifelse(is.na(cabin_maxWidth), median(cabin_maxWidth, na.rm = TRUE), cabin_maxWidth),
    cabin_maxHeight = ifelse(is.na(cabin_maxHeight), median(cabin_maxHeight, na.rm = TRUE), cabin_maxHeight),
    
    # Jaring pengaman untuk berat kabin jika kombinasi Kelas+Maskapai benar-benar kosong semua
    cabin_maxWeightPerPiece = ifelse(is.na(cabin_maxWeightPerPiece), median(cabin_maxWeightPerPiece, na.rm = TRUE), cabin_maxWeightPerPiece),
    
    cabin_sizeUnit = ifelse(is.na(cabin_sizeUnit) | cabin_sizeUnit == "", "CM", cabin_sizeUnit),
    
    # Placeholder wajib untuk unit berat kabin agar syntax konversi tidak rusak
    cabin_massUnit = ifelse(is.na(cabin_massUnit) | cabin_massUnit == "", "KG", cabin_massUnit)
  ) %>%
  
  # --- E. PARSING WAKTU & STANDARDISASI SATUAN ---
  mutate(
    departure.time = ymd_hms(departure.time),
    arrival.time = ymd_hms(arrival.time),
    
    # Konversi LB ke KG untuk Bagasi Tercatat
    checked_maxTotalWeight = ifelse(checked_massUnit == "LB", checked_maxTotalWeight * 0.453592, checked_maxTotalWeight),
    checked_maxWeightPerPiece = ifelse(checked_massUnit == "LB", checked_maxWeightPerPiece * 0.453592, checked_maxWeightPerPiece),
    
    # Jangan lupa! Konversi LB ke KG juga untuk Berat Kabin
    cabin_maxWeightPerPiece = ifelse(cabin_massUnit == "LB", cabin_maxWeightPerPiece * 0.453592, cabin_maxWeightPerPiece),
    
    # Konversi INCH ke CM untuk Dimensi Kabin
    cabin_maxLength = ifelse(cabin_sizeUnit == "INCH", cabin_maxLength * 2.54, cabin_maxLength),
    cabin_maxWidth = ifelse(cabin_sizeUnit == "INCH", cabin_maxWidth * 2.54, cabin_maxWidth),
    cabin_maxHeight = ifelse(cabin_sizeUnit == "INCH", cabin_maxHeight * 2.54, cabin_maxHeight),
    
    # Menyeragamkan semua label teks unit menjadi standar metrik
    checked_massUnit = "KG",
    cabin_massUnit = "KG",
    cabin_sizeUnit = "CM"
  )

6. Mengkonstruksi Data

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)

full_data <- full_data %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. EKSTRAKSI WAKTU DASAR
    dep_month = month(departure.time),
    dep_date = day(departure.time), # EKSTRAK TANGGAL (1-31)
    dep_hour = hour(departure.time),
    dep_day = as.factor(wday(departure.time, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)),
    
    # Durasi penerbangan dalam hitungan jam (dari format detik)
    total.time_hours = total.time / 3600,
    
    # 2. Efek Musim & Kebiasaan Penumpang
    # Akhir pekan (Minggu=1, Sabtu=7 di lubridate)
    is_weekend = as.factor(ifelse(wday(departure.time) %in% c(1, 7), "Ya", "Tidak")),
    
    # Jam sibuk orang dinas/kantoran (06:00 - 09:00)
    is_rush_hour = as.factor(ifelse(dep_hour >= 6 & dep_hour <= 9, "Ya", "Tidak")),
    
    # Kategori waktu penerbangan (Dini hari biasanya paling murah / red-eye flight)
    kategori_waktu = cut(dep_hour,
                         breaks = c(-1, 4, 11, 15, 19, 24),
                         labels = c("Dini Hari", "Pagi", "Siang", "Sore", "Malam"),
                         right = TRUE),
    
    fase_desember = as.factor(case_when(
      dep_date <= 10  ~ "Normal_Awal_Bulan",       # Harga cenderung stabil/murah
      dep_date <= 19  ~ "Pra_Nataru_Creeping",     # Harga mulai merangkak naik, sekolah mulai libur
      dep_date <= 25  ~ "Puncak_Arus_Natal",       # Puncak tertinggi pertama (orang mudik/liburan Natal)
      TRUE            ~ "Puncak_Tahun_Baru"        # Tanggal 26-31: Puncak kedua (liburan Tahun Baru)
    )),
    
    tanggal_berangkat = as.Date(departure.time),
    tanggal_sampai = as.Date(arrival.time),
    is_overnight = as.factor(ifelse(tanggal_sampai > tanggal_berangkat, "Ya", "Tidak")),
    
    # Ekstraksi Kasta Nomor Penerbangan
    # Ambil digit pertama dari flight.number (misal penerbangan 6370 -> ambil 6)
    flight_prefix = as.factor(substr(as.character(flight.number), 1, 1)),
    
    # Total bagasi yang bisa dibawa (checked + kabin)
    total_weight_allowed = coalesce(checked_maxTotalWeight, 0) + coalesce(checked_maxTotalWeight, 0),
    
    # Apakah penerbangan premium (business + bagasi berat)
    is_premium = as.factor(ifelse(kelas == "BUSINESS" & checked_maxTotalWeight > 20, "Ya", "Tidak")),
    
    # 3. FITUR INTERAKSI & STRUKTURAL
    # Rute spesifik penerbangan 
    route_code = as.factor(paste(departure.airport.code, arrival.airport.code, sep = "-")),
    
    # Menghitung estimasi jumlah transit dari daftar maskapai (Ide yang sangat bagus dari kodemu!)
    carrier_count = str_count(carriers, "'[A-Z0-9]+'"),
    
    # Jika beratnya 0 anggap ini tiket tanpa bagasi
    is_no_baggage = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(cabin_massUnit) | cabin_massUnit == 0, "Ya", "Tidak")),
    
    # Panjang digit nomor penerbangan (flight pendek = maskapai besar)
    flight_number_length = as.factor(nchar(as.character(flight.number))),
    
    # Apakah maskapai LCC (Low Cost Carrier) Indonesia
    is_lcc = as.factor(ifelse(
      primary_carrier %in% c("QG", "ID", "IW", "XN"), # Citilink, Batik, Wings, XpressAir
      "Ya", "Tidak"
    )),
    
    # Interaksi jumlah kabin × berat kabin
    total_cabin_capacity = cabin_maxPiece * coalesce(cabin_maxWeightPerPiece, 0),
    
    # Nomor penerbangan genap/ganjil
    # (Konvensi umum: genap = arah balik, ganjil = arah pergi)
    is_even_flight = as.factor(ifelse(as.integer(flight.number) %% 2 == 0, "Ya", "Tidak"))
  )

# Mengonversi kolom teks sisa dan fitur baru menjadi faktor (wajib untuk pemodelan)
kategorik <- c("currency", "kelas", "checked_luggageType", "checked_ruleType", 
               "cabin_luggageType", "kategori_waktu")

full_data[kategorik] <- lapply(full_data[kategorik], as.factor)
library(dplyr)

full_data <- full_data %>%
  mutate(
    # ==========================================
    # 1. VOLUME KABIN
    # ==========================================
    # Kalau NA, kalikan jadi 0 (karena toh ga dapet kabin/gagal scrape)
    cabin_volume = coalesce(cabin_maxLength * cabin_maxWidth * cabin_maxHeight, 0),
    
    # ==========================================
    # 2. STATUS TRANSIT & KELAS
    # ==========================================
    is_direct_flight = as.factor(ifelse(flight.stops == 0, "Ya", "Tidak")),
    interaksi_kelas_rute = paste(kelas, route_code, sep = "_") # Untuk grouping Target Encoding
  )
# ==========================================
# 3. TARGET ENCODING LEVEL 2 (Rute + Kelas)
# ==========================================
# Hitung rata-rata harga berdasarkan KELAS dan RUTE (Eksklusif dari data Train)
harga_dasar_kelas_rute <- full_data %>%
  filter(is_train == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(interaksi_kelas_rute) %>%
  summarise(mean_price_kelas_rute = mean(total.price, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

rata_rata_global <- mean(full_data$total.price[full_data$is_train == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)

# Join kembali ke full_data
full_data <- full_data %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(harga_dasar_kelas_rute, by = "interaksi_kelas_rute") %>%
  mutate(
    # Timpa kalau ada interaksi kelas_rute di test yang ga pernah muncul di train
    mean_price_kelas_rute = coalesce(mean_price_kelas_rute, rata_rata_global)
  ) %>%
  # interaksi_kelas_rute bentuk teks aslinya dibuang saja agar kardinalitas tidak meledak,
  # kita cukup pakai versi angkanya (mean_price_kelas_rute)
  select(-interaksi_kelas_rute)
view(full_data)

buat_plot_importance <- function(data_imp, judul, warna) {
  ggplot(data_imp, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Importance), y = Importance)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = warna, alpha = 0.8) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = judul, x = "Fitur", y = "Tingkat Kepentingan") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
}

# ---- MODEL 2: XGBOOST ----
# Menyiapkan matriks untuk XGBoost
xgb_train_mat <- sparse.model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = train_split)
xgb_val_mat <- sparse.model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = val_split)

# Menyamakan kolom validasi dengan train
missing_val_cols <- setdiff(colnames(xgb_train_mat), colnames(xgb_val_mat))
if(length(missing_val_cols) > 0) {
  zero_mat_val <- Matrix(0, nrow = nrow(xgb_val_mat), ncol = length(missing_val_cols), sparse = TRUE)
  colnames(zero_mat_val) <- missing_val_cols
  xgb_val_mat <- cbind(xgb_val_mat, zero_mat_val)
}
xgb_val_mat <- xgb_val_mat[, colnames(xgb_train_mat)]

dtrain_split <- xgb.DMatrix(data = xgb_train_mat, label = y_train_split)
dval_split <- xgb.DMatrix(data = xgb_val_mat, label = y_val_split)

xgb_params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror", 
  eta = 0.05, 
  max_depth = 6
)

xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = xgb_params,
  data = dtrain_split,
  nrounds = 500,
  evals = list(train = dtrain_split, val = dval_split), 
  early_stopping_rounds = 50,
  verbose = 0
)

)

set.seed(123)

cat("\nKesimpulan: Pemenangnya adalah", pemenang)

Kesimpulan: Pemenangnya adalah LightGBM
if (pemenang == "XGBoost") {
  
  # 1. Ambil best_iteration langsung dari atribut model (anti-NULL)
  n_iter <- as.integer(xgb.attributes(xgb_model)$best_iteration)
  
  # 2. Retrain menggunakan 100% data
  final_xgb_mat <- sparse.model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = train_df)
  dtrain_full <- xgb.DMatrix(data = final_xgb_mat, label = train_y)
  final_model <- xgb.train(params = xgb_params, data = dtrain_full, nrounds = n_iter_xgb, verbose = 0)
  
  # 3. Rakit ulang dtest agar kolom match dengan train
  test_xgb_mat <- sparse.model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = test_df)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(colnames(final_xgb_mat), colnames(test_xgb_mat))
  if(length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    zero_mat <- Matrix(0, nrow = nrow(test_xgb_mat), ncol = length(missing_cols), sparse = TRUE)
    colnames(zero_mat) <- missing_cols
    test_xgb_mat <- cbind(test_xgb_mat, zero_mat)
  }
  test_xgb_mat <- test_xgb_mat[, colnames(final_xgb_mat)]
  dtest_fresh <- xgb.DMatrix(data = test_xgb_mat)
  
  # 4. Prediksi Final
  prediksi_final <- predict(final_model, dtest_fresh)
} else if (pemenang == "LightGBM") {
  
  # --- Penyelamatan Iterasi Otomatis LightGBM ---
  # Paksa konversi ke integer murni
  n_iter_lgb <- as.integer(lgb_cv$best_iter)
  
  # Retrain 100% data
  final_lgb_mat <- sparse.model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = train_df)
  dtrain_full_lgb <- lgb.Dataset(data = final_lgb_mat, label = train_y)
  final_model <- lgb.train(params = lgb_params, data = dtrain_full_lgb, nrounds = n_iter_lgb, verbose = -1)
  
  # Format Matriks Uji
  test_lgb_mat <- sparse.model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = test_df)
  missing_cols_lgb <- setdiff(colnames(final_lgb_mat), colnames(test_lgb_mat))
  if(length(missing_cols_lgb) > 0) {
    zero_mat_lgb <- Matrix(0, nrow = nrow(test_lgb_mat), ncol = length(missing_cols_lgb), sparse = TRUE)
    colnames(zero_mat_lgb) <- missing_cols_lgb
    test_lgb_mat <- cbind(test_lgb_mat, zero_mat_lgb)
  }
  test_lgb_mat <- test_lgb_mat[, colnames(final_lgb_mat)]
  
  # Prediksi Final
  prediksi_final <- predict(final_model, test_lgb_mat)

} else if (pemenang == "Random Forest") {
  
  # Retrain 100% data
  rf_full_data <- train_df
  rf_full_data$total.price <- train_y # Gabungkan target
  final_model <- ranger(formula = total.price ~ ., data = rf_full_data, num.trees = 500, seed = 123)
  
  # Prediksi Final
  prediksi_final <- predict(final_model, test_df)$predictions

} else if (pemenang == "Decision Tree") {
  
  # Retrain 100% data
  dt_full_data <- train_df
  dt_full_data$total.price <- train_y # Gabungkan target
  final_model <- rpart(formula = total.price ~ ., data = dt_full_data, method = "anova")
  
  # Prediksi Final
  prediksi_final <- predict(final_model, test_df)

}
submission <- data.frame(
  x = test_x, 
  total.price = prediksi_final
)

cat("\n=== PREVIEW PREDIKSI FINAL ===\n")
